title: Runtime Observability for Heterogeneous Attention Memory
abstract: arXiv:2608.05863v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Modern models no longer keep a plain KV cache: latent caches, learned sparse selectors and recurrent states each carry the model's memory in a different form, and each fails differently under compression. We give a runtime observability contract that covers all four memory classes with three operators, instantiate it on six model configurations across five architecture families, and compose the per-stage bounds into an executable request-level risk ledger. Contracts carry their error metric as a type -- composition is only defined when metrics match, and this check rejected our own first composed chain; the repaired chain crosses metrics through two proved bridges, and whatever no formal system can certify is measured instead, dropping the composed tier to empirical automatically: every claim is certified, partially certified, or empirical, composition inherits the weakest tier, and the tier is decided by the machine. translated_title: 异构注意力内存的运行时可观测性
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.05863v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：现代模型不再仅仅保留简单的KV缓存：潜在缓存、学习型稀疏选择器和循环状态各自以不同形式携带模型的记忆，并且在压缩下各自以不同方式失效。我们给出一个运行时可观测性契约，覆盖所有四类内存，使用三个操作符，在五个架构族的六种模型配置上实例化它，并将各阶段界限组合成一个可执行的请求级风险账本。契约将其误差度量作为类型携带——组合仅在度量匹配时定义，这个检查拒绝了我们自己最初组成的链；修复后的链通过两个证明过的桥跨越度量，任何形式系统无法证明的内容则被测量，自动将组合级别降为经验性：每个声明都是已认证、部分认证或经验性的，组合继承最弱的级别，该级别由机器决定。重放于$（此处摘要截断，但翻译保持原文完整性）
tldr: 本文提出了一种运行时可观测性契约，通过类型化误差度量确保不同内存类别的组合安全性，并自动分级认证声明。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a runtime observability contract with typed error metrics to ensure safe composition across heterogeneous memory classes, automatically tiering claims as certified, partially certified, or empirical.
